name: Raven Queen
description: After the other deities depart, the Raven Queen approaches the party alone. Her form shifts between a regal, masked humanoid and a shadowy, harpy-like figure with black wings. She reveals she was once mortal and has walked among mortals, which she says lets her understand mortal perspectives. She admits she has witnessed Sylan and Dana on the Everfalls and that the party has exceeded some of her expectations, expressing confidence in Sylan's determination while acknowledging Walker and Ord have begun to prove themselves. She offers to guide the party but warns them not to waste her time or their lives, and not to treat death frivolously—implying that some members may have very few chances remaining. She confirms she has given Sylan a weapon and that he serves as a talon of her order, explicitly describing him as "a talon of my order, not a butcher." In final counsel, she urges him to value life rather than expect death, then departs by transforming into a winged, shadow-covered form and flying away.
